_doc: Read by gate 2b of the door (`src/mcgyvr/serving/gate-scripts/02-rig.py`). srv1-cpu-saturation is the footprint-versus-stream test: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B UD-IQ3_XXS on srv1 at --parallel 8 with 30, 36 and every one of its 40 expert blocks in host RAM, the lock's own harness (mcgyvr/fleet/harness.py) driving all eight slots, per-core CPU sampled on the rig every second while it does, and the START/END markers teed on the rig because a hard lock takes the ssh pipe with it. It starts llama-server itself from hosts.json's image for srv1 and never the serving harness, so it is not held to that harness's markers. The body is _arm.sh; each numbered step names one --n-cpu-moe.
